import base64
encode_payload = base64.encodestring
decode_payload = base64.decodestring
payload = b"abc" * 20
encoded = encode_payload(payload)
decoded = decode_payload(encoded)
print(len(decoded), len(encoded.splitlines()), decoded == payload)

time.sleep(0.02)
elapsed = timer() - started
print(elapsed >= 0.01)

example.code:
from array import array
serialize = lambda arr: arr.tobytes()
append_bytes = lambda arr, data: arr.frombytes(data)
values = array("B", [0, 127, 255])
encoded = serialize(values)
restored = array("B", [42])
append_bytes(restored, encoded)
print(restored.tolist())

example.code:
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from functools import partial
load_document = partial(json.loads, parse_float=Decimal)
document = '{"name": "雪", "price": 1.20, "available": true}'
record = load_document(document)
print(record["name"], record["price"])

这是依据真实 API 移除事件自编的最小重现。输入为 Unicode JSON 文本，保留中文名称，并通过 `parse_float=Decimal` 保留小数精度。移除废弃参数时不能连带删除有效的解析选项。
